parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing rigidity and shape to the furniture.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the base, door, and internal shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s overall stability and alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that serves as the structural skeleton of the cabinet.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support panel of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing elevation and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It distributes the cabinet’s weight evenly and ensures it stands level on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is the front panel made of MDF, designed to open and close for accessing the cabinet’s interior.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the storage space and protects the contents from dust and external exposure.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the frame, allowing opening and closing motion.
